parameters.description_en:
The video ID. You can get the video ID in one of the following ways:

- Log on to the [VOD Console](https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and navigate to **Media Library** > **Audio/Video** to find the video ID.

- After you upload a video by calling the [CreateUploadVideo](~~55407~~) operation, the video ID is returned in the `VideoId` parameter of the response.

- After you upload a video, you can call the [SearchMedia](~~86044~~) operation to find its ID. The ID is returned in the `VideoId` field of the response.
parameters.description_zh:
视频ID。可通过以下方式获取：
- 通过控制台上传的视频，可登录[点播控制台](https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择**媒资库** > **音/视频**查看视频ID。
- 通过[CreateUploadVideo](~~55407~~)接口上传视频时，视频ID为返回参数VideoId的值。
- 视频上传后，可通过[SearchMedia](~~86044~~)接口查询视频ID，为请求后返回参数VideoId的值。
